text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A grand stage held once a year, where Classic and Senior-class Umamusume gather to compete for the prestigious Autumn Shield.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, to those girls, it surely must be a stage that holds a far more special meaning—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off to the paddock.
Why don't you head over to the owners' seats or something?
choice_data_list: I'll go watch starting from the paddock.
I'll go watch starting from the paddock.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right. In that case, make sure you stand
with a firm, resolute posture, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even from up above the paddock,
I can spot you right away, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You two really came, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. I mean, it's not every day
you get a race that looks this interesting, right?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Golden Generation is all assembled!
Which Umamusume will seize this year's Shield?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...And the main character of this generation, too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, your own desire to "claim this race"
has been showing plain as day for a while now, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, it's fine.
As long as everyone's hearts are as one.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I want to beat everyone too.
...No, I *will* beat them.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there's no need to hold back or go easy.
Let's clash in a race with everything we've got, shall we?
